Container.Name: RecipeManager
Container.Overview: A self-hosted recipe manager with URL importing, Mealie migration, shopping lists with Woolworths price lookup, calculators, user management, and SMTP notifications.
Container.Description: A self-hosted recipe manager with URL importing, Mealie migration, shopping lists with Woolworths price lookup, calculators, user management, and SMTP notifications. On first launch visit the web UI to create your admin account.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Path to store database and config

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: SMTP server hostname (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Leave blank to disable email.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP port. Use 465 for SSL or 587 for STARTTLS.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP login password or app password

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Session encryption key. Leave blank to auto-generate.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as (Unraid default 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as (Unraid default 100 = users)

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 if running behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, NPM, Traefik) so rate limiting sees real client IPs.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 when serving over HTTPS to mark session cookies Secure.
